name: J·普雷斯珀·埃克特
bio_short: 美国电气工程师和计算机先驱。他拥有天才般的工程才能，解决了成千上万个真空管协同工作的稳定性难题，与约翰·莫奇利共同发明了ENIAC（`eniac_computer_1945`）。两人后来制造了第一台商用计算机UNIVAC，不仅开创了电子计算时代，也奠定了现代计算机工业的基础。
bio_short_en: An American electrical engineer and computer pioneer. Possessing genius-level engineering skills, he solved the stability issues of making thousands of vacuum tubes work together and co-invented ENIAC with John Mauchly (`eniac_computer_1945`). The duo later built the first commercial computer, UNIVAC, launching not only the electronic computing era but also the foundation of the modern computer industry.
